calls.summary:
# Scott / Rémy
Date: 2026-10-06 | Duration: 36m

## Summary
The team planned a tailored Bakra fintech demo covering feature flags, A/B testing, approval workflows, safe rollouts, impact metrics, and funnel insights for KYC and funding steps serving 500,000 monthly active users. Pricing was outlined at $1,200 per user plus a $50,000 platform fee, but user volume, event usage, managed warehouse limits, and deployment details remain open; Bakra lacks its own warehouse and cloud deployment is currently assumed. Initial integration requires a dedicated frontend engineer for approximately one day to implement the SDK and flags. The team also noted limitations including no visual editor in Pro, no mobile visual-editor support, no Microsoft Teams or Slack integrations, and limited enriched user-data export. Rémy Marin will lead an interactive demo under 60 minutes, with Scott Keller adding client context. Echo’s contract remains under review, while delayed Q4 deals—including one worth $200,000—are increasing pipeline pressure.

## Keywords
fintech, KYC, pricing, feature flags, data warehouse, AB testing

## Action Items

**Scott Keller**
Confirm number of experiments Bakra intends to run to refine pricing model (09:45)
Clarify with Bakra on data warehouse usage and event volume to finalize costs (06:43)
Schedule Echo technical meeting with Logan and Julio at 9:30 AM and confirm attendee availability (22:04)
Provide Rémy with technical information to help prep for Echo demo and respond to outstanding technical questions (20:48)
Develop backup sales plan to address potential Q4 shortfalls and replace delayed deals to meet sales targets (33:19)

**Rémy Marin**
Follow up on feasibility of exporting user ID details behind test results or provide documentation with limitations to Bakra (15:52)
Prepare for Bakra demo including recap, technical setup explanation, feature flag creation, AB test attachment, safe rollout, and approval workflow demonstration (23:13)

**Rémy Marin and Scott Keller**
Coordinate demo flow for Bakra to include dashboard insights, funnel metrics, and governance explanation (26:07)
